kind: OBSERVED LOCAL EXPERIMENT, NOT PRODUCTION V17 OR ARBITRARY LANGUAGE
testOutcome: 5 pass, 0 fail on local Node v22.16.0 before uploading

experimentalProtocol.documents: procedural factual English, fixed grammar plus 200 distractor paragraphs
experimentalProtocol.goals: start and target 4D coordinates known before first action
experimentalProtocol.testAnswerLeakage: target route hidden before action; model frozen
experimentalProtocol.physics: action coordinate transitions learned by majority; source reliability learned; explicit BFS planner

limitations: Not OpenThoughts3; not long free-form semantics. Documents use pre-programmed fact templates and regex parsing.
One source named ledger is perfectly reliable under the main test distribution.
Exact shortest route is generated by explicit BFS (as in maze); map and action mapping are observed/learned, not the search procedure.
Noise in candidate planning is seeded tie-breaking; environmental 25% chance slip is a separate stochastic event, corrected AFTER observation, not known at first prediction.
Perturbing trust distribution at test reduces success to 57/192; no general guarantee.
Not integrated in production V17, not measured on user RTX3050 Ti, no full-corpus throughput claim.
